initial.name: A · 极简工作台
initial.brief: Precise minimal software workspace. Small 190px neutral left sidebar with icon+text navigation; active 工作台 understated rounded grey background plus blue dot. Main area starts with aligned page title and blue 新建记录 button. Directly beneath, one quiet inline row of compact counts, without boxes. An expansive recent-records table/list occupies the left two thirds with generous row height, thin neutral separators and date column. A narrow right rail holds a short 待办 checklist and 下次复诊, separated by space rather than enclosing cards. A small restrained line chart sits below the records list. Corner radii 6-8px. Borders only where functionally needed. Calm, editorially restrained, precise grid. Use blue accent #315BEA.
initial.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a high fidelity shippable web app design comparison image for a Chinese personal medical-record organizer. This is visual concept artwork, not a medical recommendation. Use the title "病历工作台", not any invented brand name.
Composition: large high-resolution wide canvas, two complete, equal-sized desktop app screens side by side with a narrow neutral gutter. LEFT screen is white/light mode, RIGHT is the exact same design and content in black/dark mode. Both screens must be fully visible. Flat straight-on UI screenshot, crisp pixels, no device frames or perspective. Each screen is spacious yet useful, with genuinely readable Chinese typography. Put a small scheme title above the pair and small "浅色" / "深色" labels above the corresponding screen.
Monochrome requirement: surfaces are neutral pure white, black and grey, never tinted blue/cream/purple. One restrained accent only on the primary action, active navigation and chart line. Semantic warnings retain independent warm amber and are very limited. Minimal, clear 16px body text, page heading about 28px, normal-size labels and icons. No oversized hero type, no decorative illustrations, no glowing gradients, no marketing copy, no tiny text piles.
Theme controls: show visible sun/moon theme button and color selector in the top right of BOTH screens. The light screen has an open compact floating white rounded popover with exactly eight circular swatches: blue, purple, teal, orange-red, red, pink, amber, slate. A subtle rounded outline marks the active swatch. The dark screen shows the same control closed.
Use these exact short Chinese strings as appropriate: "工作台", "病历", "检验趋势", "设置", "新建记录", "最近记录", "待办", "核对报告", "准备复诊资料", "全部记录", "示例患者", "查看病历", "仅为示例数据". Recent records: "门诊记录" dated "2026-09-28", "检验报告" dated "2026-09-22", "治疗记录" dated "2026-09-10". Include a quiet sparkline/trend module with a short date axis, and a small next-visit text "下次复诊 10月12日". No medical diagnoses, prognosis, or invented treatment advice.
Do not use the same three equal-width metric cards template. Deliver polished UI concept art focused on hierarchy, layout and usable controls.

refinement.name: 01 · 日常工作台
refinement.description: 工作台只保留继续整理、最近记录和一条复诊提醒。
refinement.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer and UI redesign.
Asset: a polished high fidelity desktop UI concept for a Chinese personal medical record organizer. Redesign the supplied draft substantially to reduce visual burden and demonstrate expert use of whitespace.
Input images: Image 1 is an earlier generated UI draft to redesign; it supplies only the light/dark pair concept, not a fixed layout. Image 2 is the user's Pokecut style reference: borrow its softly separated sidebar, a single large rounded content canvas inset from the window edge, restrained fine borders and airy alignment. Do NOT copy its business metrics, graphs, marketing gradients, payments or English labels. The user also requested the understated task-focused desktop workspace approach seen in Codex, and Cherry Studio's constrained reading width and on-demand auxiliary panels. Use those as interaction/layout inspirations; do not invent their logos.
Output: ONE large, crisp landscape comparison sheet with TWO complete equally sized desktop app screenshots side by side, same page and data, left light, right dark. Small "浅色" and "深色" captions outside the UI. No perspective, no device frame, no illustration, no decorative backgrounds. Small page-specific sheet title. Composition must give real usable desktop area to each screen, not tiny thumbnails.
STRICT VISUAL RULES:
- Black/white/neutral greys for 98% of the interface. Light shell #f3f3f3, main canvas #ffffff; dark shell #101010, main canvas #181818. Never blue-tinted or violet-tinted backgrounds.
- One 196px quiet LEFT SIDEBAR inside each screen, and ONE large content canvas with 18px outer corner radius, inset 12px from top/right/bottom. No multiple dashboard cards, no nested cards, no table-grid prison.
- Sidebar title "病历" in modest type, then line-icon plus Chinese label navigation: "工作台", "病历档案", "检验趋势". Bottom has "设置". One compact search control. Only the active item has a subtle grey pill background.
- Main canvas top bar 56px, with one modest 16px context title on left and a compact sun/moon button plus one theme-color dot with chevron on right. Color controls CLOSED by default so they do not cover content. In the working page body the content is left aligned within a centered column about 760px wide, with generous 48-64px padding around it.
- Body text 16-17px, secondary text 14px with readable contrast, main heading about 25px medium weight. Spacious 26px line-height. No enormous bold headings, no dense footnotes, no English ornament.
- Use generous whitespace purposefully: related items 12-16px apart, sections 40-48px apart, approximately 35-45% clear whitespace in the content area. Do NOT fill every empty region with widgets.
- Exactly one restrained solid teal primary button per screen, about 40px tall. Teal #0D807B is the selectable accent demonstration, not a background color. Other controls are neutral text or subtle outline.
- No KPI/count cards, NO large chart, no checklist widgets, no colored badges on every row, no avatars, no gradients, no hovering glass layers, no redundant per-row action buttons. Essential errors or missing medical fields may be directly visible; sources/history stay behind a simple disclosure.
- These are fictional example records for layout, not diagnoses or medical recommendations. Every piece of text should be natural simplified Chinese.

PAGE: "01 · 日常工作台". In each sidebar active item is 工作台. Top-bar label 工作台.
Main column starts with a calm heading "最近的病历" aligned left, and primary button "新建记录" aligned right on the SAME row. Below, 36px breathing space and one very subtle low-height inline notice "下次复诊 · 10月12日" with a small calendar icon, with no card border and no separate big label.
Then a quiet section label "最近记录" followed by exactly three roomy 72px rows, separated only by near-invisible 1px horizontal lines. Each row has a small neutral document outline icon, a title, one readable secondary date, and a small neutral chevron at right. Exact records: "门诊记录" / "2026-09-28"; "检验报告" / "2026-09-22"; "治疗记录" / "2026-09-10". Do not repeat patient name or action buttons inside the rows. Above row list, one tiny unobtrusive "查看全部" link on the right. Below the three rows keep substantial EMPTY SPACE; don't add graphs or dashboard widgets. A small footer "示例数据" can be placed bottom-left of content canvas if needed.
Both modes have IDENTICAL geometry, text and content. Make this noticeably quieter and simpler than the draft reference.
